name: Basic read quality check
description: Check the quality of sequencing reads, trim them, check again and get one combined report.
details: Start here if you have just received sequencing data. The pipeline checks your reads with FastQC, removes adapters and poor-quality bases with fastp, checks the trimmed reads with FastQC again, and gathers all of it into a single MultiQC report you can open in a browser. Comparing the two quality checks shows whether trimming helped. You only need one FASTQ file; other samples can be run later by choosing a different file.

inputs.label: Sequencing reads
inputs.hint: One FASTQ file of single-end reads, plain or compressed (.fastq or .fastq.gz).

outputs.label: Combined quality report
outputs.hint: Open multiqc_report.html in a browser to see every check on one page.

outputs.label: Trimming summary
outputs.hint: What fastp removed, before and after.

references.label: Chen S, Zhou Y, Chen Y, Gu J. fastp: an ultra-fast all-in-one FASTQ preprocessor. Bioinformatics 2018;34:i884-i890.
Ewels P, Magnusson M, Lundin S, Kaller M. MultiQC: summarize analysis results for multiple tools and samples in a single report. Bioinformatics 2016;32:3047-3048.
